title: Spillway Workbench (SWB): cross-platform Python reimplementation of the USBR Cavitation Programs and companion tool to Cavicuspill
description:
A unified Python 3 / PySide6 workbench merging two hydraulic programs: Cavicuspill (spillway design: flood routing, WES overflow profile, cavitation screening; originally VB6, M.Sc. thesis, University of Sana'a, 2004) and EM-Py (a port of the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation “Cavitation Programs” by H. T. Falvey, 1987/1990: water-surface profile, cavitation index, damage index, aerator trajectory, equal-cavitation-number design). The two share an MDI shell, a unified application state, bidirectional geometry/damage bridges, a CLI, and a standalone Windows executable. Bundled USBR sample data: Glen Canyon, Blue Mesa, Hoover.

Honest status: the parsers, unit converter, data validator, damage-index program (Falvey 1990 Table 7.1) and controlled-pressure distributions are faithful, tested ports; the WS77/TRAJ/ECAVNO modules are algorithm frameworks pending the v1.1 validation release.
references: Falvey, H. T. (1990). Cavitation in Chutes and Spillways. USBR Engineering Monograph No. 42.
